name: @epoch/experience-protocol
description: Epoch Experience Protocol v1 — the typed, provider-neutral projection contract of the Experience layer (W011): versioned Experience Graph envelopes for 2D, 3D, animation, narrative, timeline/replay, presence and controls; tenant-scoped projection requests; an abstract device-descriptor slot; deterministic content-addressed serialization; and a typed admission-error taxonomy. A read projection of kernel state — never semantic authority (architecture lock rule 8).
